subject: Crestline private offer: MPA, billing path & acceptance milestones
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Cheng <alice.cheng@crestline.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@crestline.ai>

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: MPA + private-offer billing path (next steps)

Hi Alice / Crestline procurement —

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited by the fit and the performance numbers from the POC. I pulled together a concise mutual action plan tied to the Marketplace Private Offer (AWS) and the expected billing path so procurement and finance have what they need to close. Attached: one-page MPA (redwood-crestline-mpa-v1.pdf) and the private-offer terms we propose.

High-level asks / timeline proposal:
- Procurement review & redlines: by 2026-09-17
- Tech acceptance window (POC verification): 2026-09-18 — 2026-09-24 (Jonas will coordinate acceptance tests)
- Legal sign & PO issuance: target 2026-09-21
- Marketplace activation / invoice routing: within 48 hours of PO (Marissa will run invoice path with AWS ops)

Please confirm any additional procurement data points you need (invoice address, vendor legal name, tax forms). If these dates look tight, propose alternatives and we’ll adapt.

Attachments: redwood-crestline-mpa-v1.pdf (MPA), aws-private-offer-terms.pdf (Marketplace terms), crestline-eval-checklist.xlsx (acceptance tests)

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of GTM, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: MPA + private-offer billing path (next steps)

Naomi — thanks for the doc and clear timeline. A few quick clarifications from procurement:

1) Can you confirm the vendor legal name and W-9 equivalent? We need that to draft the PO.
2) For billing: we prefer invoices to be routed to accounts-payable@crestline.ai with PO# on the invoice. Will AWS marketplace invoices support our PO header?
3) Technical acceptance: what specific artifacts will Jonas provide for the acceptance gate (logs, latency report, signed acceptance form)?

We can aim to complete internal review by end of day 2026-09-17 if the W-9 and final MPA wording are updated. Otherwise we may need to push the PO date to 2026-09-24.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alice Cheng
Head of Procurement, Crestline Health
alice.cheng@crestline.ai

Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MPA + private-offer billing path (next steps)

Alice — thanks, answers inline below and updated MPA attached.

1) Vendor legal name / tax: "Redwood Inference, Inc." — attached W-9 copy included in aws-private-offer-terms.pdf (page 2). Let me know if you need a signed version.
2) Invoice routing + PO header: AWS Marketplace supports forwarding invoices to a custom AP email and including PO numbers when using a Private Offer. Marissa will run this with AWS Ops to confirm the exact invoice payload and timing. We will confirm whether invoices originate from AWS or Redwood depending on the Private Offer flow; either way we will ensure Crestline AP receives invoices with PO on the header.
3) Jonas will provide a brief acceptance package: 1) latency summary (50th/95th percentiles), 2) sample throughput runbook, 3) signed acceptance form (one-page) and the evaluation checklist completed (crestline-eval-checklist.xlsx).

I've attached an updated MPA (redwood-crestline-mpa-v1.pdf) with the small clarifications and a short spreadsheet with acceptance checkpoints. If procurement is happy with the wording, please flag and we can route the final MPA through Legal for signature.

Marissa / Jonas — can you both confirm you can support invoice routing verification and the acceptance package by the windows above?

Thanks,
Naomi

Subject: Re: MPA + private-offer billing path (next steps)

Alice / team — quick update on invoice path and next steps after speaking with AWS Marketplace Ops:

- AWS confirms Private Offer invoices can be routed to accounts-payable@crestline.ai and will include the PO number in the invoice metadata when the PO is issued via your procurement portal.
- Two invoice models exist: (A) AWS issues invoice directly to Crestline (preferred for Marketplace) or (B) Redwood issues invoice and reconciles with AWS. For our Private Offer we can support either; model (A) minimizes our finance processing but requires Crestline to accept AWS-origin invoices.
- Action items for closure:
  * Crestline procurement: issue PO to vendor legal name "Redwood Inference, Inc." with PO# visible on the invoice (target 2026-09-21).
  * Jonas: post acceptance package by 2026-09-18 (latency report + signed acceptance form).
  * Naomi / Naomi’s legal ops: finalize MPA and route to Alice for signature (done once procurement confirms PO language).

If procurement confirms PO issuance today, I will kick the activation with AWS Ops to ensure the Private Offer is applied and invoices routed correctly. Tossing to Alice to confirm PO timing.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
